quality_assessment: High boilerplate; ~15% signal, 85% transcript filler, ads, UI navigation
operating_rules: Auto-Research Loop: PRD → iterate → test → feedback → improve quality. Measure against metric.
Skill Iterative Refinement: Test with/without skill. Benchmark. Gather feedback. Update skill.md. Re-test. Converge on best version.
Skills Creator Workflow: /skill-creator → clarify questions → build first version → test on real example → iterate on failures
GitHub MCP Default: When using tools (n8n, Astro, Remotion), prefer MCP-connected codebases for live doc access, not training data.

named_methods./ralph-loop: Autonomous app-building loop. Iterative sprints, PRD-driven, test-driven dev, sub-agents for parallel work. Max 35 iterations.
named_methods./skill-creator: Built-in skill generator with evaluations. Runs brainstorm, PRD, implementation, testing phases.
named_methods./loop: Cron-based task runner. Interval syntax: 5m, 30m, 2h, daily. Max 3-day duration. Scope-bound to current terminal session.
named_methods.Google Workspace CLI: CLI + 92 bundled skills. Access Drive, Sheets, Docs, Calendar, Gmail, Slides natively.

specific_tactics.tactic: 5-key-metric scoring: personalization, <300 chars, clear CTA, no spam words, value not pitch. Test against 3 personas. Run 38+ experiments.
specific_tactics.key_example: LinkedIn outreach skill: 39 experiments, auto-picks best for private equity vs estate agents vs manufacturing

specific_tactics.tactic: MCP-connected: webhook trigger → OpenAI node → Gmail send → Google Sheets log. Get production webhook URL, paste into frontend.
setup_steps: Add n8n API key env var

specific_tactics.tactic: Nano Banana (image) → Kling 3.0 (animate) → Topaz/Replicate (upscale) → Vercel (deploy). Parallelizable.
WordPress HTML → Claude Code + Astro MCP → responsive site → GitHub → auto-deploy. Speed gain: 2-3x faster load than WordPress.
specific_tactics.prerequisite: Have Astro MCP installed globally or per-project

tools_named: Nano Banana Pro (Replicate): Image generation. 16:9 aspect, 2K min. ~6 cents/img.
Kling 3.0 (Replicate): Video in-betweening. Start/end frames → smooth animation. ~10-20 cents.
Replicate: API wrapper for image/video tools. Cost-effective gateway.
GitHub + Vercel: Code storage + auto-deploy pipeline.
n8n: Workflow automation. Webhooks, LLM nodes, email, sheets. Self-hosted or cloud.
Shannon (AI Pen Tester): Security analysis via Docker. 5-phase full test ~$50.
Bright Data Scraper: Web/Reddit scraping. $1.50 per 1,000 records.
ElevenLabs: Voice synthesis for video narration.
Open Responses API: Multi-modal file input endpoints.
contradictions: Loop duration: claims up to 3 days but scope-bound to terminal session. If terminal closes, loop stops. Requires active babysitting.
Ralph Wiggum autonomy: marketed as 'autonomous' but requires strong PRD + human iteration every few sprints. Not truly hands-off.
Agent Teams token cost: described as parallel collaboration benefit, but overhead is 3x+ higher. Real ROI unclear for everyday tasks.
Pixel Agents UI: painted as 'fun visualization' but reveals that normal terminal view hides decision paths, file access, API costs—all important to operators.
weird_gold: Streaming SSR in n8n: Webhook response can stream partial JSON back mid-execution, enabling real-time feedback to frontend.
Pixel Agents Iceberg Theory: Hidden decision layers in agent execution (file access, costs, API calls) only visible in visual UI, not CLI.
Scaffold Phase Autogen: 38 experiments in 4 minutes. Each is a full sprint. Lets agent auto-generate variants + test in parallel before human review.

Casting Call Doctrine (Production OS): 24-hr confirmation discipline, tier-2 standby, wardrobe photo requirement, two-strike rule. Not mentioned in s11-20 but visible in memory notes as locked doctrine.
